hong-kong-university-of-science-and-tech.tuition: 2027/28 undergraduate tuition: HKD 49,500 per academic year for local students eligible for government subsidy; HKD 260,000 per academic year for non-local students AND local students ineligible for subsidy. Status depends on identity documents and applicable residency conditions, not nationality alone. Accommodation and living costs are separate; 2027/28 accommodation price is not yet announced.
hong-kong-university-of-science-and-tech.fundingDetail: Other Qualifications scholarship: holistic selection; awards can be one-off or renewable, partial or full tuition. Published maximum is full tuition plus HKD 65,000 annually, renewable for the normal study period subject to satisfactory academic performance; no separate academic-scholarship application. Qualification-specific rules differ: the official indexed A-level page still specifies 2026/27 one-off full tuition for five A* subjects, half tuition for four (Chinese excluded); not a verified 2027 award table. Non-academic schemes require separate applications. Exact award/renewal GPA and 2027 A-level package remain unresolved.
hong-kong-university-of-science-and-tech.selection: BSc Mathematics applicants use school-based Science (Group A): Mathematics plus a senior-level Physics or Chemistry subject; interview not compulsory. High-school graduation and qualification-specific requirements apply. British-pattern example: three A-level passes or BTEC Level 3 Extended Diploma. American-pattern example: SAT >=1190 or ACT >=24 (single sitting, including Science), plus two AP scores >=3; alternatively five AP scores >=4. SAT/ACT/AP are qualification requirements, not universal tests. IELTS Academic >=6.0 is one English-proficiency route, separate from academic tests. School admission is not direct Mathematics-major admission; JUPAS/Gaokao routes are separate.
hong-kong-university-of-science-and-tech.cycle: 2027/28 international-qualification route: opens 2 October 2026; priority deadline 25 November 2026; rolling consideration from 26 November; closes 30 June 2027. Non-academic scholarship priority deadline is 25 November 2026; check the individual scheme. Closing hours not stated. These dates do not establish JUPAS or Mainland Gaokao deadlines.

national-university-of-singapore-mathema.tuition: Historical tariff for NEW AY2026/27 Humanities and Sciences students (Mathematics route): annual SGD 8,300 Singapore citizens; SGD 11,600 permanent residents; SGD 18,050 ASEAN international students; SGD 21,400 other international students, each with MOE Tuition Grant. Without the grant: SGD 36,650 annually. Covers regular semesters 1 and 2, paid in equal instalments; special-term courses and miscellaneous fees extra. International/non-subsidised prices include GST; citizen/PR GST subsidised by MOE. Cohort-based rates; not an AY2027/28 quote.
national-university-of-singapore-mathema.fundingDetail: MOE Tuition Grant is a subsidy, not a scholarship: eligible citizens receive it automatically; PR/international students apply and, if awarded/accepted, must work for a Singapore entity for three years after graduation. NUS International Undergraduate Scholarship: non-Singapore citizens applying as freshmen (not transfers), selected for academic/leadership/co-curricular merit; automatic consideration and shortlisted interviews. Covers subsidised tuition, SGD 5,800 living/year, SGD 5,000 accommodation/year, SGD 1,750 one-time computer grant; normal candidature, semester renewal at GPA >=3.5 and good conduct. No separate scholarship bond, but mandatory Tuition Grant creates the three-year obligation; concurrent awards need approval and early termination may trigger repayment. Science & Technology Scholarship separately includes Mathematics for Asian non-Singapore freshmen: subsidised tuition, SGD 6,000 living/year, SGD 1,750 computer and SGD 200 settling-in once, accommodation at lowest campus double-room rate and conditional travel allowance. Normal candidature; GPA >=3.5/good conduct each semester, SIX-year company bond, mandatory Tuition Grant, no concurrent funding and overseas-credit limits. Neither scheme guarantees an award or employment.
national-university-of-singapore-mathema.selection: Apply to Humanities and Sciences within CHS, not directly to the Mathematics major; preferred major is non-binding. Year-1 mathematics needs good H2 Mathematics/Further Mathematics or equivalent; otherwise MA1301/MA1301X bridging. Foreign applicants need high-school completion with >=12 years' education by July of application year and qualification-specific prerequisites. Historical 2026 Other High School Qualifications rules require standardised tests, not a separate English test: five APs, or ACT with Writing plus three APs, or SAT plus three APs; AP >=3 with Calculus BC required for Mathematics. ACT minimum 29 composite/8 Writing; SAT 600 Reading/Writing and 650 Mathematics, single sitting. These are academic tests, not universal language requirements; 2027 detailed qualification/test matrix not yet reissued in reviewed sources. Assessment/interview may be requested; no undergraduate supervisor requirement asserted.
national-university-of-singapore-mathema.cycle: Published AY2027/28 calendar: international qualifications except IB, and IB Diploma, 16 December 2026–17 February 2027. Singapore-Cambridge A-level: 18 February–19 March 2027; opening described as late afternoon, no precise hour. Polytechnic: 16 December–3 February; NUS High School: 16 December–4 January. Page currently marks forms CLOSED; these future dates are published, not an assertion that applications are open. Listed 2027 AP/Gaokao/HKDSE/CBSE/ISC/STPM final results must be updated within three days of release; no invented absolute upload date.

chennai-mathematical-institute-bs-hons-m.tuition: Historical 2026 BS brochure: INR 125,000 tuition per semester, two semesters annually (INR 250,000 per year, calculated). No home/foreign fee split stated. This is tuition only, not hostel/mess or application charges; 2027/28 price has not been established by a new fee schedule.
chennai-mathematical-institute-bs-hons-m.fundingDetail: Historical 2026 BS package: about 30–35 four-year full-tuition scholarships; limited fellowships pay INR 5,000/month, continued after semester 1 only with satisfactory academic performance. Means-tested tuition waiver: annual family income <=INR 800,000 qualifies for 100%, <=INR 1,200,000 for 50%; assistance processed after admission. Awards are not automatic for every entrant. A fresh 2027 package, stipend duration, precise renewal metric and foreign eligibility remain unresolved.
chennai-mathematical-institute-bs-hons-m.selection: 2027 BS (Hons) first-year entry requires Class 12 or equivalent and one common CMI undergraduate entrance examination; programme choice follows admission. The mathematics aptitude exam has objective questions and longer problems, mainly Class-12 material; it is not GRE/SAT or a postgraduate exam. Interview may be requested at committee discretion. Published Olympiad exemptions include Class-11/12 IMOTC/EGMOTC mathematics or Physics OCSC; listed Informatics routes have their own eligibility. Foreign qualification equivalence, English-test conditions and 2027 overseas/remote exam arrangements not established.

Applications expected around 1 March 2027; further details promised by February. Opening is approximate, not an exact verified admission date. Application closing and test-registration deadline not published in the reviewed announcement. Historic 2026 centre list is not a confirmed 2027 list.
